senses.gloss: mention, esp. invocation of the Lord, Divine Name.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3:4">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ</cite> top <he>לכל חדא וחדא מנהון אדכרה</he> for each benediction an invocation.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:15">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>בטילת אדכרתא</he> the use of the Divine Name in legal documents was abolished.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:2">Targ. O. Lev. II, 2</cite>; a. e.
